description: This file defines the PerformanceReviewModel class, which serves as a data serializer and API schema model representing performance review data within the OrangeHRM system. It includes metadata annotations, constructor logic to set entity data, filters, and attribute mappings, enabling serialization of PerformanceReview entities for API responses.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewModel
classes.description: A model class implementing Normalizable, used to serialize PerformanceReview entity data into an API-friendly format with defined schema annotations for documentation and data mapping.
